## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit` and `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`, then `npm run test:desktop` and `npm run test:mcp` (when the document, the export, the desktop app or the MCP server are touched)
- [ ] Preview, HTML export and PDF export looked at in a Chromium-based browser (when the document is touched)

## Checklist

- [ ] French translation added in `src/i18n.js` for new interface strings
